_comment: Synthetic values only. Copy to scripts/pipeline-properties.local.json (gitignored) and replace with the real roster. Keys under properties are the pipeline `p` labels; each value is exactly the properties-table columns the importer writes. exclude lists pipeline labels that are not managed properties (sold, notes receivable, etc.) with the reason.

exclude.Example Sold: Sold; carried as a note receivable, not a managed property. Belongs in a debt/notes module, not the rent roll.
